name: Static site cache policy
description: Cache rules for the Hugo portfolio and blog on GitHub Pages

rules.description: HTML is never edge-cached, so deploys are visible immediately
rules.expression: (http.host eq "furkankoykiran.com.tr" or http.host eq "blog.furkankoykiran.com.tr") and http.request.method eq "GET" and not http.request.uri.path contains "."

rules.description: Fingerprinted CSS, JavaScript and fonts: one year at the edge and in the browser
rules.expression: (http.host eq "furkankoykiran.com.tr" or http.host eq "blog.furkankoykiran.com.tr") and http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.uri.path matches "^/(css|js|fonts)/"

rules.description: Content-addressed images: one month at the edge and in the browser
rules.expression: (http.host eq "furkankoykiran.com.tr" or http.host eq "blog.furkankoykiran.com.tr") and http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.uri.path matches "\.(avif|webp|png|jpe?g|gif|svg|ico)$"

rules.description: Sitemap, llms.txt, ai.txt, security.txt and manifest: five minutes
rules.expression: (http.host eq "furkankoykiran.com.tr" or http.host eq "blog.furkankoykiran.com.tr") and http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.uri.path matches "\.(xml|txt|json|webmanifest)$"
